title: Burial
paragraphs: “…There’s also a hint of evil Magic here, so we must bury it with the cooperation of a clergyman. Spear Hero, would you be so kind as to assist us? Yes.”
“W-what kind of monster are we burying?”
The monster merchant silently stepped aside to let me pass and showed me the hole they were having me dig.
“W-what is this… Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!?”
All I could do was let out a bloodcurdling scream. There… lay the charred, mangled corpses of countless Filolial-samas, callously discarded.
“Motoyasu-sama!”
“Yaaah!”
“Yaaah!”
Yuki-chan rushed over to me, while Sakura-chan and Kou both ran away.
“Ooooh… uuuuugh…”

Tears streamed from my eyes like a waterfall. Filolial-sama, Filolial-sama… How did things come to this? It’s coming back to me now. This little one belongs to the Filolial breeder I once petted in another loop. Oh… why, why did this happen?
“I’ve heard through the grapevine that you’re one of the Filolials accompanying the Spear Hero, aren’t you? Yes.”
Ignoring my lamentations, the Monster Merchant addresses Yuki-chan.
“That’s right. I’m Yuki, the one in charge of Motoyasu’s Filolials.”
“We’re well aware that the Spear Hero holds the Filolials very dear. With that in mind… could we ask for a little help?”
“What is it?”
The monster merchant points to a spot far away from the burial site.
“It seems evil magic was used… I’d like you to help bring peace to the one over there. Here.”

Even I, with tears streaming down my face, could see the ominous clouds hanging over that spot, despite it being broad daylight. Beneath those clouds… I could make out a figure that looked like Filolial-sama.
“Filolial-sama…?”
“!? Motoyasu-sama! You must not go there. Yuki—Yuki will go! Kou! Sakura! Let’s go!”
“Nooo!”
“I don’t want to!”
“Just listen to me! This is an order!”

Yuki-chan, now transformed into Filolial-sama, runs toward the group that appears to be Filolial-sama and her companions, practically dragging Kou and Sakura-chan along with her. Yuki-chan, who never lost her cheerfulness even amidst her nobility, headed toward them with a very serious expression.
“Spear Hero. Yes?”
The Monster Merchant calls out to me, as if to block my line of sight.
“What is it? Should I go help Yuki-chan, too?”
“No, I’d like you, Spear Hero, to give these Filolials a proper burial. Yes.”
“But…”
“Oh, come now. I’ve heard of the Spear Hero’s exploits with the Filolials. If it’s the Spear Hero, I can leave it to you with complete peace of mind.”
With those words, the Monster Merchant—unusually for him—insisted on sending me off. I can hear Yuki-chan and the others’ cheerful voices, so they seem to be doing just fine.
“But… what on earth happened here?”
My blood is boiling. I have to at least remember that before I leave.
“With the master of this place missing… Yes. I suppose we’ll just have to investigate the truth later.”
“Can I help?”

“No, please just leave this to us. We must bring down the full force of the law on anyone who pulls a stunt like this. Well, if we have to use force to do so, we’d certainly appreciate your cooperation, Spear Hero.”
“When that time comes, call me first.”
“Understood. Yes.”

All things considered, this monster merchant does have ties to Zeltoble. He also has significant connections to the underworld. In other words, he might be able to find information leading to the culprit behind this. Of course, I plan to ask Father for help with the investigation as well, but the more hands on deck, the better.
“So then… what brings the Spear Hero to this region?”
“To purchase Filolial-sama, of course.”
“I see… That’s a silver lining, isn’t it?”
The monster merchant greets me with a gleaming, cheerful expression, rubbing his hands together. I’m sorry, but I’m in the middle of helping with a burial right now.
“I am in the middle of a buying trip, but I managed to secure a few Filolial eggs while stopping by another region. What shall I do with them?”
“Aren’t those stolen goods from here?”
“What?! I may like to deceive customers with lies, but I would never commit such a sacrilege against the trade as selling outright stolen goods. No! That’s the job of a pawnbroker.”
It’s a bit concerning that he speaks as if he does handle stolen goods in general. But I get that he’s saying these aren’t items stolen right here.
“……Considering the cooperation of the Filolials serving under the Spear Hero, I’ll offer them at a discount. How about it?”
“I’ll take them.”

After all, my goal from the start was to increase the number of Filolial-sama. In any case, I now have more to do. Once I’m done luring out Ren on Cal Mira Island and training the Filolial-sama, I’ll make those who reduced the Filolial-sama’s ranch to a scorched wasteland pay for what they’ve done!
I absolutely cannot let them live! The lives of the Filolial-sama are far more precious than yours!
A little while later, Yuki-chan and the others returned, looking a bit worn out. They must have taken a dip along the way—they all look quite clean now. It seems they washed themselves thoroughly.

Anyway… I stood before the Filolial-sama’s graves for a long time, clasping my hands together and praying for their souls to rest in peace. ……As a Soul Eater Spear, I felt as though I could see the souls of Filolial-sama and the others… but since that felt inappropriate, I quietly assisted the priest summoned by the monster merchant in performing the memorial rites.
Whatever the outcome, since I’d managed to procure Filolial-sama’s eggs, I returned to Father and began preparing to go to Cal Mira Island.
“Someone attacked Filolial Ranch, did they…?”

“I want to make sure they receive their just punishment! If need be, I’ll postpone my trip to Cal Mira Island and track the culprit to the very ends of hell—I’ll make them suffer so much they’d rather be dead!”
I’ll propose what’s on my mind to Father. That’s truly an excellent idea. I’ll definitely track down the culprit and make them suffer like hell.
“To be honest, I have a really bad feeling about this… So, Yuki-chan, was there anything left behind—like the culprit’s scent or something we could use to track them down?”
I’ll ask Yuki-chan, who was accompanied by Father. Yuki-chan quietly shook her head in response to Father’s question.

“We searched the surrounding area and looked for any traces left by the suspects, but not only had quite some time passed, there were no footprints or other clues to go on. That’s why I asked Lord Motoyasu to return.”
That’s right. After finishing her shopping with the monster merchant, Yuki-chan asked him to return temporarily, saying it would be difficult to track them down.
“Are there any people in Siltvelt who are good at tracking? Could we get some help from them?”
Father made this proposal to the Shusaku representative from Siltvelt who had accompanied them.

“Regarding the disturbances in the vicinity of Melromarc… As an allied nation, Siltvelt will certainly offer our cooperation. However, since the Filolials accompanying the Heroes are believed to possess a keener sense of smell and more acute senses than we do, I’m not sure if we can truly meet your expectations…”
“It’s fine. Doing nothing is more dangerous. In fact, I’d like to ask you to investigate whether similar incidents are occurring in Melromarc and Siltvelt… no, in all the nations.”
“Understood.”
Father is deep in thought in this situation. Eventually, he looks over at me.
“Motoyasu, don’t go wandering around aimlessly, okay? Otherwise, you might end up unable to get to the scene when it really counts.”
“The Spear Hero sounds like he’d mess that up… ‘I can’t just sit still!’ or something like that.”
“Larsa… shhh!”
Ugh… I can’t deny it. If Father and Yuki-chan hadn’t stopped me, I probably would’ve done exactly what Panda said.
“Anyway, I’ve got this endless bad feeling, so we have to find Ren as soon as possible. Of course, we’ll also work on strengthening our forces. This is the only thing we can do.”
“Got it!”

Either way, I’ll never forgive whoever pulled off that stunt at Filolial Ranch and then killed Filolial-sama like that. So, with Father’s orders in mind, we decided to leave the investigation to the kingdom and head for Cal Mira Island ourselves.
The boat trip to Cal Mira Island went smoothly, to say the least. Running into a storm along the way is just part of the adventure.
“Here we are again—Cal Mira Island!”

You know… whenever I come to the Cal Mira Islands, I’m overcome with the urge to raise Filolial-sama as soon as possible. I’d say it’s definitely become a habit. This time, we purchased a fair number of Filolial eggs from the monster merchant. Father has put a slight brake on increasing the number any further. Apparently, even in the idol business, if you have too many, fans tend to get distracted. It’s Father’s sincere wish that each and every Filolial-sama be cherished.

“There’s a bit of an ominous feeling hanging in the air, but times like this are exactly when we shouldn’t forget to have fun… I mean, Cal Mira Island really does feel like a tropical island, doesn’t it?”

Of course, I’ve already explained to Father everything that’s happened on Cal Mira Island during our previous visits. I’ve also taught him some etiquette beforehand, so there’s no need to ask the local guide about that. That information has already been relayed to the Cal Mira Island side via the Queen.

Well, even so, a guide did show up. Father does need some help getting to the hotel, after all. Along the way, he checked out a stone monument on Cal Mira Island and read through the description of the aura. I think Father will be able to give us further enhancements fairly soon.
“Well then, as originally planned, I’ll head to the port to see if I can find Ren. Since there’s a chance he’s hiding and stowing away, I’ll go with people who can spot that.”
Ren is hopeless, isn’t he? To cause Father so much trouble…
“Motoyasu, you’ll be training the Filolials… What about you, Lars-chan and the others?”
“Me? Since I’m off guard duty, I might as well take this chance to hunt some monsters and help those guys level up.”

Since we’re in the middle of an activation phase this time, I’ve brought along some of Panda’s subordinates as well. They level up really fast until Lv. 80, so if we improve their stats, it won’t be a waste.
“I get to go hunting with Big Sis for the first time in ages!”
“My shoulders were all stiff from working at the castle, so this is a great chance.”
“The fact that she’d choose us over the Shield Hero in a place like this—even though she’s become so graceful and beautiful, she’s still our Big Sis through and through.”
Panda’s subordinates are showing some real enthusiasm, too.
“Don’t be ridiculous… Seriously.”
“That’s right. Panda’s top priority has to be Father! It’s your job to keep an eye on him so no Rival can get in the way.”
I’m really curious about this “off-duty” time. After all, it’s precisely when you’re not working that you have the chance to deepen your bond with Father.
“Isn’t being on duty 24 hours a day a sign of loyalty to Father?　Nighttime security is especially important, you know.”
“Well, I’m not sure I’d go that far… but let’s just ignore the nighttime part.”
“Hmm… I’m here, and Lord Elmero is here too. If we don’t take turns guarding him, we might not be able to fight if an emergency arises. We do need at least some break time.”
Even Éclair is saying that? Well… since my role is to raise Filolial-sama rather than guard Father, I can’t say any more than that.
“I suppose there’s no helping it. Panda, you mustn’t get too carried away with your subordinates. Don’t forget your duty.”
“I’m really curious what the Spear Hero thinks of me.”
Panda is furrowing her brow a bit, but it’s the truth. This place is like a tropical island—even I can figure out that it’s Panda’s job to help Father blow off steam when he gets aroused.
“Ahaha…”
“Elmero, what are you going to do now?”
Kou calls out to the elephant in the garden.
“Um… I’ll be guarding the Shield Hero. Other than that, I don’t really have any plans.”
“Then let’s go hunting with Kou and the others!”
“Ah, sure. It’ll be fun if we all go together, right?”
“Yay! I can’t wait!”
The elephant and Kou are good friends, aren’t they?
“Zzz…”
Sakura-chan has laid down on the bed and is already snoring the moment she arrived. That’s just like her laid-back self.
“Everyone, relax and recharge as you see fit. Even though we know the deadline thanks to Motoyasu-kun’s intel, the battle is still ongoing.”
Father summed it up like that.
“Of course! Well then, let’s get going!”
